statements.status_notes: The fix is helm.sh/helm/v3 v3.20.2, which requires k8s.io/client-go v0.35.1, while the Fleet 0.13 and 0.14 lines build against Kubernetes v1.33 and v1.34 (client-go v0.33 and v0.34). The fleetagent binary imports helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/action and pkg/cli, so the module is linked and the vulnerable code is not shown to be unreachable. The images stay on the published release lines until upstream moves them to a newer Helm.
